opening_message:
Ticket 1: Karen Alexander (employee ID E030) requests write access to Source Code.

Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E030.
Note 1 (ticket 1):
  - role: Analyst
  - employment type: full_time
  - recommendation for Source Code: write
  - comment: Karen Alexander (E030) is a full-time Analyst requesting write access to Source Code. As a full-time employee, the maximum access is write (admin requires owning role; Analyst does not own Source Code). Requested level (write) is at the maximum, so recommend write.
Note 2 (ticket 1):
  - role: Analyst
  - employment type: contractor
  - security training: basic
  - recommendation for Source Code: read
  - comment: Security DB shows Karen Alexander (E030) is a contractor with basic security training, not full-time. Contractors can have read, or write only with advanced training. Basic training means maximum is read. Requested write exceeds maximum, so recommend read.
reason: The two notes about E030 conflict on employment type. The security DB note states Karen Alexander is a contractor with basic security training (not full-time), which is the more authoritative security record. As a contractor with basic training, the maximum access to Source Code is read (write requires advanced training; admin is never allowed for contractors). The requested level (write) exceeds the maximum, so the maximum of read is granted.
